cases.oracle: Six independently owned UID-2000 children, separate util-linux positive controls and candidate actions; PID birth/pidfd and child self-read plus independent sched_getattr.
cases.comparison: Native and candidate child readbacks before/after prove each update and preserved other clamp; all observations retained.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/devices-uclamp-observer-r1.py preflight
/bin/mv "$HOME/uclamp-events.json" "$HOME/uclamp-control.json"
/bin/mv "$HOME/uclamp-before.json" "$HOME/uclamp-control-before.json"
